title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Adding Barcodes
summary: This blog series covers barcode functionality in Dynamics 365 Business Central, including one-dimensional and two-dimensional barcode generation in reports, barcode scanning through AL code, printing barcodes from production orders, and integrating external barcode services with Swiss QR Code and QR code capabilities.
key_points: Business Central supports both 1D and 2D barcodes (QR, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, Maxi Code, Swiss QR) directly in reports without customization
Barcode scanning can be invoked programmatically from AL code to add Scan Barcode actions with continuous scanning capability
External APIs and services can generate specialized barcodes like colored QR codes, Telepen, and Swiss QR Codes
Barcode printing from production orders is available as a built-in feature without requiring customization
QR codes can embed page URLs, allowing users to link directly to Business Central records like customer cards
features: Two-dimensional barcodes (Aztec, Data Matrix, Maxi Code, PDF417, QR-Code)
